headlines.title: Former Cornell student alleging sexual assault addressed faculty senate in letter
headlines.description: A former Cornell student at the center of a sexual assault case that has rocked the campus says she felt unsupported by the university’s president, detailing her concerns in a letter to Cornell faculty. NBC News’ Danny Cevallos breaks down the legal and institutional fallout.

headlines.title: Christina Applegate says she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis
headlines.description: The Emmy-winning actor, who was initially diagnosed in 2021, broke down in tears on her podcast, “MeSsy,” sharing the stunning news.

headlines.title: Russia Batters Ukraine Amid Trump-Zelenskyy Standoff
headlines.description: Russia launched new attacks across Ukraine as the increasingly bitter standoff between President Donald Trump and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy heats up. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Ohio gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton condemns ad featuring her estranged mother
headlines.description: Ohio Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton is condemning a new ad circulating online featuring her estranged mother. NBC News national politics reporter Henry Gomez discusses how close the race between Acton and Republican candidate Vivek Ramaswamy has become in the campaign's final two weeks.

headlines.title: Woman sexually assaulted at fraternity near University of Chicago, lawsuit alleges
headlines.description: The new allegations mark the second case of alleged sexual assault to roil the University of Chicago in a matter of days.

headlines.title: Eagles are not being punished for handling of Jalen Hurts’ blood clots
headlines.description: The Philadelphia Eagles are not being disciplined for how they handled quarterback Jalen Hurts’ blood clots, a spokesperson for the NFL said.

headlines.title: The Senate map expands (again): From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Bridget Bowman looks at the latest red state Democrats are making a play for in the battle for the Senate.

headlines.title: Woman accused of holding stepson captive over 20 years in abusive conditions to go to trial in February
headlines.description: Kimberly Sullivan’s 32-year-old stepson told police last year he had spent almost his entire life being abused, starved and held in captivity, according to an affidavit.

headlines.title: Kyle Kennedy, granddaughter of Robert F. Kennedy, dies at 42
headlines.description: Kyle Francis Kennedy, an educator and granddaughter of Robert F. Kennedy, died last month after suffering a severe spinal cord injury.

headlines.title: Spotify says it removed 50 million ‘slop’ and spam AI tracks this year
headlines.description: Spotify removed more than 50 million tracks created by AI so far this year, as it works to keep AI-generated music from crowding out human artists.

headlines.title: Jane Doe says Cornell president appeared to question her allegations in letter to faculty senate
headlines.description: In the letter obtained by NBC News, Jane Doe said the university’s president seemed to brush off her report of a gang rape when he met with her sorority’s leader.
